## alibaba_oss

Connector: `asterdrive.storage.alibaba_oss`; owner: AsterDrive storage maintainers; fallback: repository maintainers; API: OSS REST; OSS4-HMAC-SHA256; connector config V1.

SDK/transport: `aws-sdk-s3@1.157.0`, `reqwest@0.13.5`.

Code: [src/storage/connectors/alibaba_oss.rs](https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterDrive/blob/master/src/storage/connectors/alibaba_oss.rs), [src/storage/drivers/alibaba_oss/mod.rs](https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterDrive/blob/master/src/storage/drivers/alibaba_oss/mod.rs).

Fixtures: [src/storage/drivers/alibaba_oss/tests.rs](https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterDrive/blob/master/src/storage/drivers/alibaba_oss/tests.rs).

Cloud acceptance: **not_recorded** — No cloud acceptance record is asserted by this index; local fixtures and historical PR claims are separate evidence.

| Capability | Conclusion and boundary | Official sources |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-objects"></a>Object I/O | Object serialization reuses S3; authentication is OSS V4, not AWS SigV4. | [api](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/putobject), [v4](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/recommend-to-use-signature-version-4) |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-uploads"></a>Multipart/resumable | Validate initiate/part/list/complete/abort and nonfinal part limits independently. | [multipart](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/initiatemultipartupload) |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-signing"></a>Signing/presigned | Ordinary and presigned signing covers the final host/encoded key; public and server endpoints differ. | [v4](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/recommend-to-use-signature-version-4), [presign](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/add-signatures-to-urls) |
